outputs: source codes from provided natural language intents

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'English' as the paper focuses on Python code generation, not English text. Consolidated model names (ChatGPT→GPT-3.5-Turbo, Deepseek Coder-6.7B→DeepSeekCoder). Added additional generated outputs (specifications and test cases) that are key to the MPSC framework.
Normalized all Pass@ variants to the base form 'Pass@k' as per the guideline to simplify metric variants to base form. The paper uses Pass@k with k=1,2,5 variations.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. The evaluation relies on code execution (unit tests) rather than LLM-based assessment.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluation is automated using unit tests and code execution.

overall_notes: This paper introduces MPSC, a novel framework for code generation that leverages multi-perspective consistency (solutions, specifications, test cases) to improve LLM performance. The extraction quality is generally good, with minor normalization needed for model names and metrics. The paper focuses exclusively on code generation tasks with automated execution-based evaluation (Pass@k), no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation methods are employed.
